handshake_pairs.name: DE-to-D
handshake_pairs.rule: Software asserts DE before clocking the first start bit into D; deasserts DE after the last stop bit + tHOLD.

handshake_pairs.name: RE#-to-R
handshake_pairs.rule: Software keeps RE# = LOW during receive windows so the host UART sees the bus.

handshake_pairs.name: Driver-arbitration
handshake_pairs.rule: Application protocol (Modbus master / token / TDM) enforces exclusive DE = HIGH on one node at a time.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Single shared differential bus; all nodes monitor V_AB simultaneously; only one driver may be enabled at a time on half-duplex.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Receiver R reflects current V_AB only when RE# = LOW; D drives V_AB only when DE = HIGH.
dependency_graph.failsafe_dependency: Idle V_AB is held > +200 mV by external R_B divider or by integrated transceiver failsafe biasing.

channels_bus_side_2_wire.name: A (non-inverting)
channels_bus_side_2_wire.purpose: Non-inverting differential bus line; when transmitting mark, A is the more positive line of the pair.
channels_bus_side_2_wire.active_levels: V_A - V_B > +200 mV at receiver → mark; V_A - V_B < -200 mV → space

channels_bus_side_2_wire.name: B (inverting)
channels_bus_side_2_wire.purpose: Inverting differential bus line; complementary to A.

channels_host_side.name: D / DI
channels_host_side.purpose: Driver input from host UART TX; logic level.

channels_host_side.name: DE
channels_host_side.purpose: Driver Enable (active HIGH); when LOW, driver tri-stated.

channels_host_side.name: RE# (RE)
channels_host_side.purpose: Receiver Enable (active LOW); when HIGH, receiver output tri-stated.

channels_host_side.name: R / RO
channels_host_side.purpose: Receiver output to host UART RX; logic level.

logical_signal_states.name: loss-of-signal (LOS)
logical_signal_states.value: |V_AB| < 200 mV; receiver R indeterminate unless failsafe-biased

bus_field_segments.name: IDLE_BIASED
bus_field_segments.form: Driver tri-stated; failsafe holds V_AB > +200 mV

bus_field_segments.name: DE_GUARD_BAND
bus_field_segments.form: Software-controlled blank time between DE deassert and DE reassert

ordering_rules.differential_polarity_convention: Mark = V_A > V_B; Space = V_A < V_B. Drivers and receivers from different vendors all conform to this convention so that interoperable bus operation is preserved.
